shared_elements: horizontal band or register of repeated small elements
linear incised/outlined forms without interior modelling
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic device of a horizontal row of repeated small vertical marks/figures beneath longer horizontal lines, plus a general reliance on schematic outline forms. A depicts identifiable creatures (birds, serpentine and quadruped forms) stacked in figural registers, whereas B depicts a purely geometric grid-divided rectilinear object with a comb-like fringe and no animals or figures at all.
